verses.text: Then Job answered,
“How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
lines: “How long will you torment me,
and crush me with words?

verses.text: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
lines: You have reproached me ten times.
You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

verses.text: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
lines: If it is true that I have erred,
my error remains with myself.

verses.text: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,
lines: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me,
and plead against me my reproach,

verses.text: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
lines: know now that God has subverted me,
and has surrounded me with his net.

verses.text: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
lines: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard.
I cry for help, but there is no justice.

verses.text: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
lines: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass,
and has set darkness in my paths.

verses.text: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
lines: He has stripped me of my glory,
and taken the crown from my head.

verses.text: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
lines: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone.
He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

verses.text: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
lines: He has also kindled his wrath against me.
He counts me among his adversaries.

verses.text: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
lines: His troops come on together,
build a siege ramp against me,
and encamp around my tent.

verses.text: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
lines: “He has put my brothers far from me.
My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

verses.text: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
lines: My relatives have gone away.
My familiar friends have forgotten me.

verses.text: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
lines: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger.
I am an alien in their sight.

verses.text: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
lines: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer.
I beg him with my mouth.

verses.text: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
lines: My breath is offensive to my wife.
I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

verses.text: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
lines: Even young children despise me.
If I arise, they speak against me.

verses.text: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
lines: All my familiar friends abhor me.
They whom I loved have turned against me.

verses.text: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
lines: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh.
I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

verses.text: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
lines: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends;
for the hand of God has touched me.

verses.text: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
lines: Why do you persecute me as God,
and are not satisfied with my flesh?

verses.text: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
lines: “Oh that my words were now written!
Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

verses.text: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
lines: That with an iron pen and lead
they were engraved in the rock forever!

verses.text: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
lines: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives.
In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

verses.text: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
lines: After my skin is destroyed,
then I will see God in my flesh,

verses.text: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
lines: whom I, even I, will see on my side.
My eyes will see, and not as a stranger.
“My heart is consumed within me.

verses.text: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
lines: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’
because the root of the matter is found in me,

verses.text: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
lines: be afraid of the sword,
for wrath brings the punishments of the sword,
that you may know there is a judgment.”
